intro.title: Bounty Hunting - Skyline Valley Head Hunt Boss Stats
intro.blurb: Each Skyline Valley Head Hunt boss comes with a distinct weapon setup and a signature mechanic, and the gang they bring follows the same theme. This page lists every boss by group with their weapons, health, damage and resistances, plus the gang members and support waves that fight alongside them. All numbers update with every patch.
intro.profiles: Bosses are grouped the same way as the Skyline Valley Head Hunt Groups lifetime challenges. Track your kills on the Grunt Hunt and Head Hunt Challenges page.
intro.mutations: Mutation effects used by bounty targets. One-star outlaws are named after theirs, and some Head Hunt bosses carry a forced mutation as part of their signature attack.
intro.mechanics: Skyline Valley Head Hunt bosses share the following stats.
intro.health: Health is read from the curve table assigned to each boss across the bounty level range. Bosses on the same curve share a row.
intro.damage: Damage per hit from each boss's main weapon at the bottom and top of the bounty level range.
intro.support: Every Skyline Valley Head Hunt sends one of these support waves alongside the boss and its gang. Blood Eagles are the usual wave; a few bosses bring a different one that suits their theme.
intro.npcs: Each boss brings its own gang members, listed with the boss they belong to.

sideKickMechanics.name: Belligerent Beekeepers
lines: ×1.5 damage to targets that are poisoned.

mechanics.title: Picks on the crippled
lines: ×2 damage to targets the game flags with a VATS target height of 1.

mechanics.title: Orbital strikes
lines: an alarm sounds and a targeting laser runs for 5.9 seconds, then the strike explodes.

mechanics.title: Hates your radio
lines: ×2 damage to you while your Pip-Boy radio is on.

mechanics.title: Vault-Tec weakness
lines: ×1.5 damage from players wearing Vault clothing.

mechanics.title: Vault-Tec grudge
lines: ×1.5 damage to anyone in a vault suit or one of 9 Vault-Tec outfits and hazmat suits.

weapons.name: Floater Flamer Grenade or Molotov Cocktail

mechanics.title: Mole rat waves
lines: at 80%, 60% and 30% of his health, so three waves in a full fight.
a screen message, "The Molerats are coming!", plus a 4-second camera shake. The waves hit 3 seconds after the warning.

10 Enraged Mole Rat Landminers per wave, at the hunt's three spawn markers around the area. These are the same bomb-vest mole rats as the drill section of the Gleaming Depths raid, so they run at you and blow up.

mechanics.title: Special Agent Damage
lines: a Special Agent Damage effect that watches his health.

mechanics.title: Damage jammers
lines: a screen message, "Three strange devices are limiting your damage!"
3 Jaques' Jammers around the hunt area.
while they work, Damage Inhibiting ("A nearby device is lowering your damage") cuts your weapon damage to 1% of normal; each dose lasts 60 seconds.
up to 120 seconds, then "The devices no longer restrict your damage!".

mechanics.title: Exploits Weakness to Mike
lines: ×2 damage to anyone with Weakness to Mike (his side-kicks' hits give it, 10 seconds).

sideKickMechanics.name: Radioactive Raiders
lines: Their hits give you Weakness to Mike for 10 seconds, which lowers your Damage Resistance.

mechanics.title: Stealth Killers backup
lines: he brings in Stealth Killers, up to 3 at a time.
extra ones can spawn when a player goes down.

mechanics.title: Self-heal
lines: a "Bounty Healing Effect" on his Health (magnitude 19) while alive.

mechanics.title: Gun-crew aura
lines: players near him deal ×2 damage with ranged ballistic weapons.

mechanics.title: Lightning crew
lines: a screen message, "The Underpaid Crew Members are calling down lightning!"
a channel takes 6 seconds; the caster glows blue and gains 50 Damage Resistance while channelling. Deal 5,000 damage to stagger it.
lasts 12 seconds and gives ×2 weapon damage.

sideKickMechanics.name: Underpaid Crew Members
lines: The side-kick half of the boss's lightning mechanic.

mechanics.title: Hard to hit on the move
lines: the faster she moves, the less damage she takes:
full damage at speed 10 or slower
weapon, explosion, limb and spell damage.

mechanics.title: Poison flower patches
lines: 20 flower patches scattered around the fight.
standing in one deals 33 poison damage per second (Flower Vulnerability).

mechanics.title: Disciple shield
lines: while his disciples are alive he takes reduced weapon and explosion damage, stepping up as they die off:
"A disciple has died, and The Inquisitionor weakens!"
"All disciples are dead, and The Inquisitionor's defenses are gone!"

mechanics.title: Field promotions
lines: when a ranked pirate dies, a Crewmate is promoted: a screen message, "Death in the ranks has triggered a field promotion!", a pirate hat, a 5-second glow and a new weapon (Dragon, Black Powder Rifle or Black Powder Pistol).

sideKickMechanics.name: Crewmates
lines: Can be promoted and pirate weapon list (Dragon, Black Powder Rifle or Black Powder Pistol).

mechanics.title: Incisor
lines: melee and unarmed hits ignore 75% of your armour.

mechanics.title: Exploits Red Scare
lines: ×2 damage to anyone with Red Scare (from his Subjugator Grenade, 25 seconds).

mechanics.title: Time bubble
lines: the closer you get, the slower you move (four rings):
inside ring 80: 15% slower ("Time is slowing down")
inside ring 40: 45% slower ("Time slows to a crawl")

mechanics.title: Swift-Footed
lines: +60% movement and attack speed and +40% reload speed.

mutations.intro: Mutation effects used by bounty targets. One-star outlaws are named after theirs, and some Head Hunt bosses carry a forced mutation as part of their signature attack.

list.name: Chameleon
list.detail: Turns invisible while it stands still.

list.name: Freezing Touch
list.detail: Melee hits slow the target down.

list.name: Herd Mentality
list.detail: Weaker alone, stronger while grouped with its gang.

list.name: Plague Walker
list.detail: Emits a poison aura while it is sick.

list.name: Unstable Isotope
list.detail: Forced Unstable Isotope — can release a radiation burst when struck.
